plan.melodySummary: The theme passes from Flute to Trumpet to Alto Sax and finally to Bassoon, each entry supported by imitative echoes and a walking continuo bass, so every instrument carries the tune for one four-bar phrase. Terraced dynamics climb from a gentle !mp! opening to a brilliant !f! climax in the running-eighth phrases, then settle back to a warm !mf! resolution on the final sustained D.

sections.label: Phrase A
sections.notes: State the theme cleanly at !mp!, even quarter-note pairs, gentle Baroque phrasing; Alto Sax enters one bar later imitating your opening figure below your dynamic.

sections.label: Phrase B
sections.notes: Take the melody at !mf!, clear and terraced; Flute weaves a stepwise countermelody in eighths above but stays under your line, Bassoon walks steady quarters.

sections.label: Phrase C
sections.notes: Drive the continuous eighth-note sequences at !f!, this is the climax; project each step-wise sequence, Flute answers a bar later in imitation, Trumpet gives sustained functional harmony beneath you.

sections.label: Phrase D
sections.notes: Carry the descending eighth-note runs at !mf!, warm and singing; add a cadential trill into m.16 and hold the final D8. Flute decorates above, Alto Sax takes the walking bass while Trumpet and Flute supply harmony.

Flute.instruction: Open the theme at !mp! with clean Baroque articulation, then serve as the imitative countermelody voice in eighths through the rest of the piece, always sitting under the current melody carrier's dynamic; add a light cadential trill in m.16.

Trumpet.instruction: Tacet in Phrase A, then present the theme at !mf! with terraced, non-crescendo phrasing; afterwards provide sustained functional harmony at a lower dynamic than the active melody, joining the full climax texture.

Alto Sax.instruction: Begin as imitative inner voice echoing the Flute a bar late in Phrase A at !p!, take the running-eighth theme at the !f! climax in mm.9-12, then drop to a walking-quarter bass line in mm.13-16 under Bassoon's melody.

Bassoon.instruction: Play a strictly functional walking continuo in steady quarters through mm.1-12, then rise to carry the descending eighth-note theme at !mf! in mm.13-16 with a cadential trill and the held final D.
